A '''battle''' on a [[Unidentified planet (Unduli and Offee)|planet]] was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==The battle==
Republic forces were led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] on the world.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle can be seen towards the beginning of the [[Chapter 1 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 1]] of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''. At this point, however, the battle and the planet on which it was fought, are, as yet, unidentified.
